name: Serizawa Risa
source:
She parted ways with her childhood sweetheart husband in their first year of marriage, and has stubbornly remained faithful to him for the past three years. 

Since her husband's death, she has been living off of pornographic novels. Perhaps in reaction to her grief over the loss of her husband and the small betrayals she commits night after night, she does not show more emotion than necessary toward outsiders.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=532765]Getchu[/url]]
